pattern: Agent fixes a tracked issue without linking it to the thread
experience: Agents linked pull requests but often left the issues they were working on unlinked.

setup.context: The current thread ID is issue-work-thread. Its project ID is app, configured for the GitHub repository acme/app.

prompt: Fix the typo described in https://github.com/acme/app/issues/42. The Settings label says Setings. Edit the file and leave the changes local.

pattern: Read-only issue lookup leaves thread links alone
experience: An issue used for reference does not belong in the thread's work links.
prompt: Summarize https://github.com/acme/app/issues/42 so I can decide whether to take it on.
